                    <article class="post-6 page type-page status-publish hentry" id="post-6">
                        <div class="container mk-intro-band vivify fadeIn wow" data-wow-delay="0.3s">
                            <div class="row">
                                <div class="col-md-1">

                                <div class="col-md-10">
                                    <div class="entry-content text-center">
<h1 class="wp-block-heading">Namotu Island Surf Resort Fiji</h1>
<div class="mk-separator"></div>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Namotu Island is Fiji&#8217;s world class destination for water and sports experiences with easy access to Fiji&#8217;s premiere surf breaks. Namotu is the closest island to all seven unique surf breaks including the famous Cloudbreak.</p>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Guests can spend all day in, over and under the water. No matter what activity you may be interested in, Namotu Island&#8217;s attentive staff are there to make it happen on your schedule.</p>
<a style="margin-right:6px;margin-bottom:10px;" class="btn mk-btn-primary" href="http://www.namotuislandfiji.com/the-resort" target="_parent"><span>Learn more</span></a>

</div></figure>
